top_signals.title: ATF confirms “major incident” after recent Qilin breach claims
top_signals.summary: ATF, the regulatory agency that enforces federal laws governing firearms and explosives in the United States, has confirmed that one of its systems was compromised after breach claims made by the Qilin ransomware gang. [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Better launches Bitcoin-backed mortgages powered by Coinbase
top_signals.summary: Better and Coinbase have launched a crypto-backed mortgage product that lets US homebuyers pledge Bitcoin as collateral for a down payment without having to sell it.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Salesforce stock jumps 12% on AI growth and Anthropic investment gain
top_signals.summary: Salesforce's Anthropic stake led to higher profit in the latest quarter.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Takaichi begins meeting with LDP executives ahead of expected Cabinet reshuffle
top_signals.summary: Personnel changes would come as her administration looks to shore up public support and strengthen its position within the party before the autumn session of parliament.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Installation of 35-Ton Propeller Sets the Stage for SMM 2026
top_signals.summary: The giant ship propeller supplied by Mecklenburger Metallguss (MMG) will once again take its place in front of the Hamburg exhibition halls. On Thursday, August 27, the maritime heavyweight will return to the exhibition grounds, providing a visible signal that SMM 2026 is about to begin.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: SOL treasury firm DeFi Development launches real-time ‘State of Solana’ intelligence platform
top_signals.summary: The Nasdaq-listed company holds roughly 2.3 million SOL worth about $208 million, while its shares have fallen 16% year to date.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Snowflake ends service-account passwords. Now comes the hard part
top_signals.summary: Snowflake is ending password authentication for legacy service accounts, forcing organizations to migrate them to passwordless methods. Token Security explains why the harder challenge is identifying what uses each account, who owns it, and how much access it still needs. [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Core Lightning confirms multiple vulnerabilities, prepares security update
top_signals.summary: Core Lightning advised operators to use offline mode if they do not install the forthcoming update, keeping their nodes active but disconnected.
